identification: Vintage enamel 'The Daily Telegraph, Tasmania, Leading Newspaper' advertising sign, blue/white, 15x53 cm, 'Made in England' mark, corner chips (4 photos viewed incl. back). Daily Telegraph was a Launceston newspaper (1883-1928, merged into the Examiner).
